home_hero_subtitle: Provide an assembly video recording, optionally map components via a BOM CSV or digital STEP model, and let our AI orchestrator design high-fidelity instruction drafts.
home_upload_phase_hint: Analysis runs after upload. Track its progress on the next screen.
home_pipeline_media_desc: Extract keyframes and detect scene cuts.
home_pipeline_segment_desc: Segment steps using AI model context.
home_pipeline_draft_desc: Write steps, captions, and tool listings.
home_gallery_empty_body: Choose a video file on the left to begin drafting your first assembly instructions manual.
auth_login_subtitle: Sign in to access and manage your assembly manuals.
auth_register_subtitle: Start drafting assembly manuals with AI context mapping.
auth_register_success_body: Please check your email inbox to confirm your account before logging in.
auth_set_new_password_subtitle: Enter your new password below to update your account.
auth_reset_subtitle: We will send you a secure recovery link to reset your password.
auth_recovery_sent_body: Please check your email inbox for a link to reset your password.
auth_password_updated_body: Your password has been changed. You can now use the application.
editor_readonly_banner: This is version {version}, a read-only snapshot. Open the latest version to edit; you can still export this one.
editor_failed_body: The processing run encountered an error. Please try uploading the source video again.
editor_delete_confirm: Permanently delete this failed manual? This cannot be undone.
editor_wait_note: This workspace will refresh automatically and open the interactive step editor as soon as the processing status transitions to {status}.
editor_enrich_body: Got the parts list or CAD after recording? Attach it to create version {version} on the same step timeline. The engine re-maps parts and re-illustrates without re-watching the video. This version stays as a snapshot.
editor_regen_body: Queues an AI pass on the saved manual. Save your edits first. The step comes back as {status} for you to re-confirm.
editor_regen_prompt_placeholder: What should change? e.g. “mention the 4mm hex key” or “make the arrow clearer”
editor_regen_queued: Regeneration queued. Reload in a moment to see the updated step.
